text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, dopamine hydrochloride has been on the FDA shortage list for 108 months since the initial posting on 2017-11-06. The three listed manufacturers — Baxter Healthcare, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., and Hospira Inc. — all show Current status. Corvale East holds 12.3 days of supply, Corvale General holds two lots totaling 23.5 days, and Corvale Lakeside holds 13.8 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA records list Baxter Healthcare, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., and Hospira Inc. with Current shortage status. Hikma's label names HIKMA FARMACÊUTICA (PORTUGAL) as the manufacturing plant; the plant is not placed in our records. Hospira's registered plant (FEI 1021343) has a history of OAI inspections in 2010 and 2011 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-12; the most recent inspection was NAI on 2025-02-07.

Our position: Current inventory across sites provides roughly 12–14 days of supply at present usage. The rule‑selected alternate manufacturer is HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place. Buyer must verify HealthFirst's supply reliability and confirm the manufacturing site before committing to purchase.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to verify HealthFirst supply reliability and confirm manufacturing site; requires P&T Committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Henry Schein, Inc. as an alternate source; requires P&T Committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC as an alternate source; requires P&T Committee approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate ProPharma Distribution as an alternate source; requires P&T Committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing or protocol changes are recommended; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
